title: Los Angeles weather: Cool, dry weather expected in Southern California before another chance of rain moves in - ABC7 Los Angeles
text:
Los Angeles weather: Cool, dry weather expected in Southern California before another chance of rain moves in - ABC7 Los Angeles 
 24/7 Live Los Angeles Orange County Inland Empire Ventura County California Weather 
 SoCal to see sunny, mild Saturday before another chance of rain moves in 
 Southern California is drying out just in time for the weekend, but two more rounds of rain are in the forecast. Saturday, November 21, 2026 3:33AM Share Follow ABC7 on Google Este artículo se ofrece en Español LOS ANGELES (KABC) -- Southern California is drying out just in time for the weekend, but two more rounds of rain are in the forecast.
 High temperatures Saturday are expected to reach the upper 60s across many areas of the region under mostly sunny skies.
 Conditions are expected to change Sunday as a storm system moves through, bringing a chance of rain as early as Sunday afternoon. While rainfall is not expected to be significant, showers could continue into Monday morning.
 Looking ahead, there's a chance for rain Wednesday into Thanksgiving morning.
 Meanwhile, the coast is bracing for potentially record-breaking king tides next week. A coastal flood advisory is expected to be in effect next week.
 Weekend forecast
 Los Angeles and Orange counties Saturday can expect a high of 68 degrees and a low of 50. There's a 30% chance of showers on Sunday.
 The valleys and Inland Empire Saturday will see a high of 68 degrees and a low of 43. Shower chances are also at 30% on Sunday.
 Beach communities Saturday can expect a high of 67 degrees and a low of 51. Showers are also expected Sunday into Monday morning.
 Mountain communities on Saturday will see a high of 45 degrees and a chilly overnight low of 17. There is a 10% chance of rain on Sunday.
 Desert areas can expect sunny conditions with a high of 57 and a low of 32 Saturday, with Palm Springs reaching a high of 71.
